quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: capital expenditures were $4,367 million in 2025 versus $3,231 million in 2024. Lumen says rising labor, materials and energy costs increased capital expenditures particularly to support its continued PCF buildout, and that advance payments under PCF agreements fund network expansion and simplification projects, which will increase capital expenditures. The Mass Markets Fiber-to-the-Home divestiture (closed February 2, 2026) is expected to reduce Mass Markets fiber-related capital expenditures by approximately $1 billion annually.
